Government proposes tax rule changes to attract offshore funds

The Indian government has proposed amendments to tax laws aimed at attracting offshore funds and boosting electronics manufacturing. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is expected to introduce a Bill in the Lok Sabha that will offer concessions to overseas investors. The proposed changes include extending tax exemptions for specified electronic goods by ten years and widening steps to attract foreign investment by easing existing rules.
